brandIdentity.name: cl0ud
brandIdentity.positioning: Autonomous cyber-physical systems architecture, high-fidelity creative engineering, and pragmatic open-source robotics documentation.
brandIdentity.purpose: To bridge the gap between high-level autonomous intelligence and tangible physical machines through rigorous systems engineering, transparent attribution, and open architectural standards.
brandIdentity.mission: Deliver reproducible, robust, and beautifully documented engineering systems—spanning quadruped robotics, world-model simulations, IoT automation, and spatial web platforms—while empowering student and peer engineering teams through modular technical assistance.
brandIdentity.vision: A global open ecosystem where complex hardware, autonomous agents, and mechatronics are documented with industrial clarity, attributed with integrity, and built with craftsmanship.

values.description: Reject superficial wrappers and fragile consumer demonstrations in favor of authentic low-level mechatronics, custom fabrication, and verified system drivers.
Never claim ownership of peer, team, or institutional intellectual property. Attribute every line of code, CAD geometry, and circuit layout with precision.
AI models must ground in physical reality with fail-safe hardware limits, isolated electrical domains, and predictable kinematic boundaries.
Every system must be accompanied by comprehensive monographs, register maps, electrical schematics, and interactive visual aids.

doList: Explain the physics, kinematics, and protocols under the hood.
Credit institutional partners, open-source maintainers, and teammates prominently.
Use concrete SI units (N·m, m/s, AWG, mm, ms, Hz).
Distinguish verified hardware implementations from simulations and theoretical concepts.
dontList: Do not use generic buzzwords or hollow marketing hyperbole.
Do not obscure collaborator or school team contributions.
Do not present unbuilt software as fully deployed physical systems.
Do not misspell cl0ud as Cloud or CLOUD unless referencing a specific project designation (e.g., Project CLOUD).

messaging.elevatorPitch: cl0ud is an engineering lab and brand architecture ecosystem founded by Ojas Singh, developing autonomous robotics, world-model simulators, and cyber-physical IoT systems with cinema-grade documentation and ethical peer attribution.
messaging.oneLiner: Autonomous cyber-physical systems engineered with precision and documented with clarity.
messaging.boilerplateShort: cl0ud represents the engineering initiatives, robotics platforms, and open-source systems architecture developed and co-engineered by Ojas Singh.
messaging.boilerplateLong: cl0ud is an engineering brand, research lab, and systems architecture ecosystem founded by Ojas Singh. Spanning quadruped robotics, spatial computing, robotic arm world models, and environmental automation, cl0ud provides open-source firmware, custom mechatronics fabrication, and standardized attribution frameworks for peer and institutional engineering teams.

taglines.primary: Engineered with Precision. Attributed with Integrity.
taglines.secondary: From Latent Embeddings to Physical Kinematics.
taglines.exhibition: Powered by cl0ud | Engineered for Impact.

brandIdentity.brandStory: cl0ud emerged from late-night prototyping benches, soldering irons, and terminal sessions at DPS Indirapuram. What began as an ambition to transcend turnkey consumer robotics evolved into an engineering standard: that every robotic platform—from the Unitree Go2 quadruped patrol steward to mobile tracking systems and automated hydroponics—deserves aerospace-grade electrical isolation, reproducible firmware, and crystal-clear attribution.
usagePrinciples: The zero '0' in cl0ud signifies binary determinism, clean resets, and computational grounding.
cl0ud must always be paired with the appropriate attribution level when appearing on collaborative or school exhibition projects.
cl0ud may never be used to imply unilateral ownership over collaborative work.

placementGuidelines: In collaborative posters, place the cl0ud badge in the bottom technical credits plinth alongside institutional logos.
In code repositories, place the 'Powered by cl0ud' badge in the top README badge ribbon.

svgSpecifications.precision: 2 decimal places, cleaned SVG paths with no raster artifacts
svgSpecifications.strokeWidth: 2.5px standard vector stroke with round joins

typography.monoFont: JetBrains Mono, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace

motionPrinciples: Kinematic Accuracy: Motion transitions should feel physically grounded with smooth ease-out curves (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).
Subtle Luminescence: Interactive cards pulse gently with a 0.3s transition on hover.
Zero Jank: All animations must maintain 60-120 FPS by avoiding un-composited properties.
visualDesignSystem.uiStyle: High-contrast dark architectural aesthetic with semi-transparent frosted cards (backdrop-filter: blur(12px)), hairline slate borders (border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), and electric cyan accent highlights.
visualDesignSystem.engineeringDiagramsStyle: Clean SVG and Mermaid flowcharts using dark obsidian containers, aerospace blue flow paths, and electric cyan decision nodes with monospace register labels.
visualDesignSystem.presentationStyle: Apple Keynote-inspired widescreen (16:9) cinematic layouts, dark space backgrounds, full-bleed hardware photography, and bold, readable typography.
visualDesignSystem.exhibitionDisplayStyle: Physical plinth and poster design using brushed titanium borders, high-contrast matte black backgrounds, white bold captions, and luminous cyan attribution badges.

termsAndConditions.legalNotice: PROPOSED TERMS & CONDITIONS FRAMEWORK: This document outlines the proposed operational terms for the cl0ud brand, open-source engineering assets, and collaborative attribution. This text serves as an architectural baseline and must be formally reviewed by qualified legal counsel before commercial enforceability.
termsAndConditions.brandUsage: The 'cl0ud' name, zero-glyph logo, and associated visual marks are proprietary brand assets associated with Ojas Singh. Third parties and collaborators are granted a non-exclusive, revocable license to display cl0ud marks solely for accurate technical attribution in verified engineering collaborations.
termsAndConditions.logoUsage: Logos must be rendered strictly according to the specifications in `brand/logo/logo-specifications.md`. Stretching, skewing, color shifting, or altering the internal spark of the zero glyph is strictly prohibited.
termsAndConditions.attributionRequirements: Any project incorporating cl0ud software libraries, circuit schematics, or CAD designs must prominently display the appropriate attribution badge as defined in `attribution/guidelines/attribution-rules.md`.
termsAndConditions.projectOwnership: Display of the cl0ud badge or branding NEVER transfers ownership of an external creator's project, intellectual property, or code to cl0ud. Collaborative projects remain the property of their respective student authors, teams, or academic institutions.
termsAndConditions.contributorRecognition: All human contributors, student peers, faculty mentors, and open-source upstream projects must be acknowledged in repository documentation and project plaques.
termsAndConditions.intellectualProperty: Original software, CAD files, and documentation authored strictly by cl0ud are licensed under the designated open-source licenses (MIT for code, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for brand marks and assets). Third-party code retains its original licensing.
termsAndConditions.thirdPartyAssets: Third-party libraries (e.g., ROS 2, Unitree SDK, Three.js, Meta JEPA) remain the property of their respective trademark and copyright holders. cl0ud claims no affiliation or endorsement by these entities.
termsAndConditions.openSourceLicenses: Permissive code licensed under MIT or Apache 2.0 allows free modification and reuse provided original copyright notices and license texts are preserved.
termsAndConditions.permissionToReuse: Educational institutions, student robotics clubs, and hackathon teams are granted free, royalty-free permission to reuse cl0ud schematics and templates for non-commercial educational purposes.
termsAndConditions.permissionToModify: Engineering code may be modified under the terms of its repository license. Brand logos and wordmarks may NOT be modified or repurposed as new logos without explicit written approval.
termsAndConditions.commercialUsage: Commercial use of the cl0ud brand, name, or proprietary logo requires prior written agreement from brand administrator Ojas Singh. Open-source code components may be used commercially in compliance with their individual MIT/Apache licenses.
termsAndConditions.nonCommercialUsage: Non-commercial academic, research, and hobbyist projects may display cl0ud attribution badges freely to reflect authentic engineering assistance.
termsAndConditions.disclaimer: ALL CL0UD ENGINEERING ASSETS, CAD DESIGNS, ELECTRICAL SCHEMATICS, AND CODE ARE PROVIDED 'AS IS', WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT.
termsAndConditions.liabilityLimitations: IN NO EVENT SHALL CL0UD, OJAS SINGH, OR PROJECT COLLABORATORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES, ELECTRICAL SHORTS, BATTERY THERMAL RUNAWAY, ROBOTIC MECHANICAL COLLISIONS, OR OTHER LIABILITY ARISING FROM THE USE OF THESE MATERIALS.
termsAndConditions.collaborationAgreements: Collaborative project parameters should be memorialized using the template provided in `templates/collaboration-template.md` to establish clear contribution boundaries prior to exhibition or release.
termsAndConditions.disputeHandling: Any concerns regarding attribution inaccuracies, misrepresentation, or branding disputes shall be resolved amicably through direct contact with Ojas Singh at ojasctc@gmail.com.
termsAndConditions.termination: Permission to display the cl0ud brand mark may be terminated immediately upon written notice if attribution rules are violated or if the brand is used in bad faith.
termsAndConditions.privacy: cl0ud does not collect telemetry or personal data through its static documentation, CAD repositories, or brand specification files.
termsAndConditions.documentationAccuracy: While every effort is made to maintain factual accuracy across all technical monographs, physical hardware specifications and experimental results should be independently verified before high-current or high-speed field testing.

brandGovernance.approvalProcess: Requests for novel attribution formulas, co-branding partnerships, or commercial licensing must be submitted via GitHub Issue or email to ojasctc@gmail.com.
brandGovernance.assetChangeManagement: All changes to logos, color tokens, and schemas must be submitted as Pull Requests with corresponding changelog entries following Semantic Versioning.
brandGovernance.versioningRules: Brand specifications adhere to SemVer: Major (breaking redesign/schema changes), Minor (new verified projects or asset formats), Patch (typo fixes or token adjustments).
complianceChecklist: Is the zero '0' retained in all text representations?
Is the correct attribution formula applied according to the contribution level?
Are all third-party contributors and institutions credited?
Does the logo meet the minimum clear space and contrast requirements?
Has the JSON specification been validated against the official schema?
brandGovernance.exceptionHandling: Temporary exhibition variances (e.g. customized physical acrylic plinths) may be authorized by the administrator provided brand integrity is maintained.

repositoryGovernance.branchingStrategy: Trunk-based development with `main` as the default production branch. Feature additions and schema updates should branch from `main` as `feat/<topic>` or `fix/<topic>`.
repositoryGovernance.versioning: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 (SemVer) with tagged Git releases for milestones.
repositoryGovernance.pullRequestGuidelines: Pull requests must include a summary of changes, confirmation of JSON Schema validation, and no broken internal markdown links.
repositoryGovernance.changelogStandard: Keep a Changelog format maintained in `CHANGELOG.md`.
repositoryGovernance.securityPolicy: Security vulnerabilities in automated tools or firmware must be reported confidentially to ojasctc@gmail.com per `SECURITY.md`.
repositoryGovernance.documentationMaintenance: Documentation is treated as production code and updated in the same commit as technical changes.

integrityRules: JSON must parse without syntax errors and contain no duplicate keys.
All project entries must reference verified contribution levels.
All referenced SVG and document paths must exist in the repository.
